## Technical Qualifications & Verification Facts
- 30+ years service in Indian Air Force as an Aeronautical Engineering Officer.
- Key contributions in Defence Capital Acquisition under Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP):
  - Technical appreciation, feasibility evaluation, and formulation of Service Qualitative Requirements (SQRs) / Technical Specifications across Design & Development (D&D), IDDM (Indigenously Designed, Developed and Manufactured), Make in India, and Global categories.
  - Capital procurement and lifecycle support contributions to major programmes: Next Generation Close Combat Missile (NGCCM), Dhruvastra (Helina anti-tank guided missile), Long Range Surface-to-Air Missile (LRSAM), Close-In Weapon System (CIWS), High-Power Radar (HPR), SU-30 MKI and MiG-29 aeroengine overhauls, Mi-17 V5 helicopter MRO setups, and Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS) integrations.
- Leadership in MRO Infrastructure Modernization:
  - Directed modernization of aircraft servicing facilities, engine test benches, and avionics test stations at Air Force Base Repair Depots (BRDs).
  - Led 16 engineering officers and 100+ senior airmen technical staff in conducting training programmes that qualified and certified over 1,000 aviation technical personnel for I-line (operational flight-line) and II-line (intermediate depot-level) maintenance certifications.

## Core Consultancy Services Offered
1. Technology Consultancy (RFI/RFP & Defence Strategy):
   - DAP/DPP category advisory (Make-I, Make-II, IDDM, Global).
   - Technical proposal review, compliance matrix preparation, and offset advisory for Indian and global aerospace OEMs.
2. Aircraft MRO & Sustenance:
   - Setting up indigenous MRO facilities, Transfer of Technology (ToT) absorption, spares supply pipelines, test bench qualification, and lifecycle sustainment protocols.
3. Aviation Leasing & High-Tech Asset Advisory:
   - Technical lease management, pre-lease inspections, redelivery condition reviews, and high-value asset valuation.
4. Defence Project Management:
   - Programme milestone tracking, liaison with Project Management Groups (PMG), flight-line certification workflows, and operational readiness audits.
5. Aerospace Supply Chain Support & Indigenization:
   - Tier-1/2/3 vendor localization, quality audit readiness, import substitution for aviation consumables, and MIL-SPEC compliance.
6. Technical Academia & Aviation Training Setup:
   - DGCA CAR 147 / CAR 66 maintenance training curriculum alignment, military-to-civilian conversion pathways, and technician upskilling frameworks.
